Canvases can form a knowledge base. A canvas id may contain `/`, so a folder of files is a tree of canvases.

- The library is a tree, with a Folders view and a Knowledge view. Knowledge follows each `<project-name>/index` through the canvases it links to.
- `<CanvasLink to="reference/mcp-tools">` links one canvas to another. Agents follow those links with `list_links`, `backlinks`, and `search_linked` (HTTP routes match).
- `examples/okf` is a worked example. Serve it with `team-canvas serve examples/okf`. Those ids start at `team-canvas/index`.
